$comment: NYSE market calendar. Authoritative source: https://www.nyse.com/trade/hours-calendars (NYSE Group Holiday and Early Closings Calendar). Retrieved 2026-07-28. This file exists so the live executors never rely on model recall for the holiday schedule, which goes stale silently. early_close_1300 days close at 1:00 PM ET; any slot at or after 1:00 PM ET must end silently on those days. Extend this file before 2029 or the executors will abort rather than guess.

notes.2026-07-03: Independence Day observed; July 4 2026 falls on a Saturday.
notes.2028-01-01: New Year's Day 2028 falls on a Saturday and is NOT observed by NYSE, so there is no January holiday entry for 2028.
notes.dst: America/New_York switches EDT->EST on 2026-11-01. All slot windows are expressed in ET and converted at runtime for this reason.
